definition: Opioid use disorder is a mental health condition involving disordered use of opioid drugs. In the source, it is described as a major public health crisis associated with opioid withdrawal and with high illness, death, and economic burden.

reasons: The packet text does not define opioid use disorder as a “mental health condition” or as “disordered use of opioid drugs,” so those substantive claims in the definition are not supported by the provided source.
Because the definition’s first sentence is unsupported, the overall definition cannot be considered defensible against the packet.

The packet supports that opioid use disorder is a public health crisis with substantial economic cost, morbidity, and mortality, but it does not define it as a “mental health condition involving disordered use of opioid drugs.”
The claim that it is “associated with opioid withdrawal” is not supported by the packet; the packet only says ketamine may be used as an adjunct during treatment of opioid withdrawal.
The definition adds a general clinical explanation beyond the source and is not limited to the wording and scope provided in the packet.
